title: Change app background colour to sickly green

requirements.text: Replace the current chocolate-brown app background colour with a sickly green tone (a muted, slightly nauseating yellow-green such as #8DB600 or oklch equivalent) across the global theme. Update the relevant CSS custom properties in frontend/src/index.css and/or frontend/tailwind.config.js so the new background applies consistently in both light and dark modes.

quotes: chnage the background colour to sickly green

acceptanceCriteria: The main app background is visibly sickly green (a muted, yellowish-green hue) rather than the previous chocolate-brown.
The background colour is defined via the design system tokens (CSS variables or Tailwind config) so it applies globally.
Both light and dark mode backgrounds reflect the sickly green theme.
No other intentional design colours (header, footer, cards) are unintentionally altered.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Redesigning any component colours beyond the app background.
